integrity: Proof and independent finite combinatorial checks supplied; no claim of independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact fixed-space homeomorphism is for pole reversal preserving each arm and unordered distinct particles. It neither computes general arm-permutation subgroup fixed spaces nor any quotient configuration space. The radial-tree homotopy result and its rank are prior results; the all-particle geometric fixed classification is the assessed contribution. No independent validation or definitive literature-priority certification.
title: Pole-reversal fixed configurations on every finite multitheta graph
